stories.title: UAE pardons Egyptian dissident-poet al-Qaradawi
stories.summary: UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed pardoned Egyptian opposition poet Abdul Rahman al-Qaradawi, who faced 10 years in prison over charges tied to his activism and was extradited from Lebanon in January 2025. The pardon closes a case that had drawn international scrutiny to the UAE's treatment of political critics.

stories.title: Boy, 12, dies after car hit by train in County Mayo
stories.summary: A 12-year-old boy died when the car he was traveling in was struck by a train at a level crossing at Kiltybo near Ballyhaunis, Ireland, on Thursday evening. Gardaí are investigating the collision, which has left the local community in shock.

stories.title: Malaysia declares emergency in Sarawak as haze worsens
stories.summary: Malaysia declared a state of emergency in Sarawak state's Serian district after thick haze from wildfires in neighboring Indonesia pushed air pollution to hazardous levels. Authorities are urging residents to limit outdoor activity as the cross-border smoke event persists.

stories.title: Nvidia commits DLSS 5 to RTX 40 GPUs this fall
stories.summary: Nvidia confirmed its DLSS 5 upscaling technology will reach GeForce RTX 40-series cards later this fall, though no exact date is set. The move extends the next-generation upscaler to the previous GPU generation.

stories.title: Google patches Chrome V8 zero-day exploited in the wild
stories.summary: Google shipped an emergency Chrome update fixing a V8 JavaScript-engine zero-day that attackers were actively exploiting. Users are urged to update immediately, as the flaw was being used in attacks before the fix landed.

stories.title: US and China set mid-September AI safety talks in Beijing
stories.summary: Washington and Beijing are preparing a new round of AI safety dialogue in Beijing for mid-September, the latest step in a fragile bilateral channel on frontier-model risks. The talks come as both governments race to set AI governance rules.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO launch slips to mid-October, could top $2T
stories.summary: Anthropic's IPO is now expected to launch in mid-October rather than late September, with sources saying the deal could value the AI firm above $2 trillion. The delay gives Anthropic more time to line up investors as markets weigh AI valuations.

stories.title: Saturday Dawg Chow: Browns news roundup
stories.summary: SB Nation's September 5 edition of the Dawg Chow rounds up the week's Browns headlines, including items on Mike Hall Jr., Jerry Jeudy and Deshaun Watson ahead of the regular season. A quick-read digest for fans catching up on the team.

stories.title: Browns defensive line getting healthy at right time entering opener
stories.summary: The Browns' defensive line, the position group hit hardest by training-camp injuries, is nearing full health just before the season opener, per the Beacon Journal. The timing gives Cleveland a boost up front as Week 1 approaches.

stories.title: Day seeks clean opener as No. 1 Ohio State hosts Ball State
stories.summary: Ryan Day wants the top-ranked Buckeyes to play a clean opener against Ball State on Saturday at Ohio Stadium, with a marquee Texas matchup already looming next week. Ohio State opens as a 50-point favorite in its title-defense season opener.

stories.title: F1 Qualifying Today: Italian GP 2026 start times
stories.summary: Qualifying for the Italian Grand Prix at Monza takes place Saturday (10 a.m. ET), with Lewis Hamilton chasing Kimi Antonelli in the title fight while Antonelli starts from the back after an engine penalty. Ferrari's home crowd will expect a strong showing.

stories.title: F1 expert: 'Brilliant' new Red Bull signing is 'massive mistake' for Aston Martin
stories.summary: An F1 pundit argued Red Bull's signing of Aston Martin's Tom McCullough is a 'massive mistake' for the Silverstone squad, calling him a brilliant engineer they can ill afford to lose. Red Bull confirmed the hire as it reshapes its senior technical leadership.

stories.title: Columbus Weather: Pre-sunrise storms could be strong Saturday
stories.summary: Scattered thunderstorms could be strong across Columbus before sunrise Saturday, according to ABC6's forecast, kicking off an unsettled stretch through the Labor Day weekend. The storm timing matters with a busy holiday weekend of events ahead.
